def girth(G):
    g = float('inf')
    for v in G.nodes():
        # BFS
        dist = {v: 0}
        parent = {v: None}
        from collections import deque
        q = deque([v])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for w in G.neighbors(u):
                if w not in dist:
                    dist[w] = dist[u]+1
                    parent[w] = u
                    q.append(w)
                elif parent[u] != w:
                    g = min(g, dist[u]+dist[w]+1)
    return g
